rules.name: ouat178-sp-diagnostic
rules.sql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name, p.proname AS procedure_name, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS args, pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) AS owner, p.prosecdef AS security_definer FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE p.proname = 'sp_create_price_ratio_wp' ORDER BY n.nspname
SELECT current_user AS db_user, current_setting('search_path') AS session_search_path, current_setting('track_functions') AS track_functions
SELECT r.rolname, r.rolcanlogin, r.rolconfig::text AS role_settings FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolcanlogin AND left(r.rolname, 3) <> 'pg_' ORDER BY r.rolname

SELECT r.rolname, n.nspname AS schema_name, has_function_privilege(r.oid, p.oid, 'EXECUTE') AS can_execute, has_schema_privilege(r.oid, n.oid, 'USAGE') AS schema_usage FROM pg_roles r CROSS JOIN pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE r.rolcanlogin AND left(r.rolname, 3) <> 'pg_' AND p.proname = 'sp_create_price_ratio_wp' ORDER BY r.rolname, n.nspname
SELECT schemaname, funcname, calls, round(total_time::numeric, 1) AS total_ms FROM pg_stat_user_functions WHERE funcname = 'sp_create_price_ratio_wp'
SELECT id, author, dateexecuted, exectype FROM opera.databasechangelog WHERE id LIKE '%price-ratio%' OR id LIKE '%correl-product-mapping%' ORDER BY dateexecuted
SELECT product_code, primary_code, secondary_code, primary_multiplier, secondary_multiplier FROM opera.correl_product_mapping WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu ORDER BY product_code
SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, count(*) AS mapping_rows FROM opera.correl_product_mapping GROUP BY tenant_id, business_unit ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND (underlying_id LIKE 'CM QW %' OR underlying_id LIKE 'CM SB %')) AS s1_leg_settle_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu) AS s2_valuation_date_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.security_info_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu AND status = 'Active' AND derivative_type LIKE '%cs_spread%' AND security_id LIKE '%CM WP%') AS s3_active_wp_spread_securities, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.security_info_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu AND status = 'Active' AND derivative_type = 'future' AND security_id LIKE '%CM WP%') AS s4_active_wp_future_securities

WITH legs AS ( SELECT a.underlying_id, a.value_date FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table a JOIN opera.security_info_table c ON c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.status = 'Active' AND c.derivative_type LIKE '%cs_spread%' AND c.security_id LIKE '%CM WP%' AND CONCAT('CM ', 'QW', ' ', LEFT(c.contract_month, 3)) = a.underlying_id WHERE a.tenant_id = :tenant AND a.value_date <= (SELECT v.value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table v WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant AND v.business_unit = :bu) UNION SELECT a.underlying_id, a.value_date FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table a JOIN opera.security_info_table c ON c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.status = 'Active' AND c.derivative_type LIKE '%cs_spread%' AND c.security_id LIKE '%CM WP%' AND CONCAT('CM ', 'SB', ' ', RIGHT(c.contract_month, 3)) = a.underlying_id WHERE a.tenant_id = :tenant AND a.value_date <= (SELECT v.value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table v WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant AND v.business_unit = :bu) ), per_leg AS (SELECT underlying_id, count(*) AS dates FROM legs GROUP BY underlying_id) SELECT count(*) AS distinct_legs, COALESCE(sum(dates), 0) AS leg_dates, COALESCE(sum(GREATEST(LEAST(dates, 31) - 1, 0)), 0) AS expected_ratio_rows_per_mapping_row FROM per_leg

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.settlement_price_table_wp WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu) AS actual_ratio_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.underlying_price_table_wp WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu) AS actual_price_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.recon_scicom_correlation_input WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu AND correl_12 IS NOT NULL) AS correl_not_null

expect.reason: the procedure exists exactly once; two copies make the unqualified CALL depend on the search path
no mapping rows means the procedure loop does nothing and raises no error
the ratio path needs Active cs_spread WP securities
the legs must have settle values up to the valuation date
the procedure built exactly the rows its own joins predict
